game.q: his companions tell the Prophet ﷺ. what does he say first?

wrong.mix: not first. first, he wanted the man’s own reason.
wrong.basic: no. he never brushed it off.

game.right: YES. he asked why, first. and the answer was love.

end.line: a man recited the same short surah every time because he loved it. and God loved him.
end.l2: God loves him, came the answer.

cliff.s2: God tells the angels a plan, and they ask a question.

share: four lines. every prayer. every single time. surah al-ikhlas, on infinite hill
